editor.entity_helper: Pick a sensor.*_next_departure produced by this integration.
editor.name: Title
editor.name_helper: Optional override for the card heading.
editor.hide_header_helper: Hides the icon tile, stop name, subtitle and maps link. Hero and departure list remain visible.
editor.show_hero_helper: Big countdown for the next departure.
editor.max_departures_helper: Cap the rendered list. Card-side filters (lines + Fußweg) trim rows BEFORE this cap, so setting it to 10 doesn't guarantee 10 rows. If you see fewer than expected, raise the integration's 'Departures to fetch' under Settings → Devices & Services → Linz Linien Austria → Configure — that's the pool the card filters from. Set 0 to render only the next-departure block above without any rows.
editor.lines_helper: Empty (no chips selected) = show every line. Tap chips to toggle which lines to keep. Tight filters at busy stops (Hauptbahnhof) may need the integration's 'Departures to fetch' raised so the card has enough pre-filter rows to find matches.
editor.lines_custom_placeholder: Add a line not shown above (press Enter)
editor.show_platform_helper: Show the platform / bay (Steig) on the next-departure subtitle and at the trailing edge of each row.
editor.show_alerts_helper: Show the collapsible traffic-info banner above the departure list when LINZ AG has active service notices.
editor.pulse_live_helper: Animate the green dot in front of realtime-corrected minute counts. Defaults on. Users with the OS prefers-reduced-motion preference get a static dot regardless of this toggle.
editor.enable_animations_helper: Add a one-shot card-mount fade-in plus longer-duration colour transitions (line badge recolour as the next departure changes mode-of-transport, hero accent shift, row hover tint, alerts banner fade). Defaults off for a calm static look. Honoured prefers-reduced-motion still wins.
editor.per_line_hint: Walk time (Fußweg): drop a departure when its countdown is below this many minutes — you couldn't catch it anyway. Colour: override the line badge tint. Raise the integration's `Departures to fetch` if a long walk leaves too few rows visible.
editor.per_line_no_data: Pick an entity above to see its lines here.
